Get KenPom's program ratings

Source: R/kp_historical_tables.R
kp_program_ratings.Rd

Get KenPom's program ratings

Usage

kp_program_ratings()

Value

A data frame with 17 columns:

col_nametypesdescription
rknumericRk.
teamcharacterTeam-side label or team identifier.
confcharactercharacter.
rtgnumericRtg.
best_rknumericBest rk.
best_yrnumericBest yr.
worst_rknumericWorst rk.
worst_yrnumericWorst yr.
kp_mediannumericKp median.
top10numericTop10.
top25numericTop25.
top50numericTop50.
chnumericCh.
f4numericF4.
s16numericS16.
r1numericR1.
chgnumericChg.

See also

Other KenPom Historical Functions: kp_coach_history(), kp_conf(), kp_confhistory(), kp_confstats(), kp_pomeroy_archive_ratings(), kp_team_history()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(kp_program_ratings())
